rationale: The replication successfully reproduces all six symmetry-dictated sub-claims (Kramers protection, d-wave/g-wave patterns, η-controlled switching, mode switching, spin-Hall on/off) using a minimal tight-binding surrogate. However, no actual DFT or rt-TDDFT calculations were performed—the paper's core computational method and material-specific results (KNiF3 band structure, 4.36 eV gap, fs lattice dynamics, charge AHC of ±400 S/cm) remain untested. The surrogate validates the symmetry mechanism but not the quantitative DFT predictions. Machine-precision matches are expected by construction, reducing their evidential weight. This is honest model-surrogate work, but coverage is limited since the crux compute target was scoped out.
